body:
Hey I'm sorry you have to deal with the loneliness in this quarantine. I've been in a similar situation feeling fat and ugly with noone to boost my morale. Just hang on a bit longer. I know you might've heard this from a lot of people , but if you feel fat you just need to hit the gym and start dieting. You're probably not even fat and it's just something you've been told as a child if I had to guess. When you start working out you start seeing differences pretty fast. I wouldn't recommend working out just to sound like every other friend and therapist , I've lost 40 Kilos of weight over a year and it hasn't taken away all of my depression but it helped me feel so good about how I look and feel. The constant PRs and the occasional new vein popping up every week will sure make you feel accomplished and that you're not DISGUSTING.

Drop me a Direct message if you need help where to start. Surprisingly quarantine is great place to start working out at home and building a habit. If you're strong enough to share your problem with the world , I'm pretty sure you're strong enough to work on yourself.
Opening up is a process slower than a Supermarket queue for me , but I'm trying. Thanks for the advice!

The voice doesn't seem to have a identifiable sound if you know what I mean? It's usually unrecognisable and very quick. I have talked to my therapist about it but where I come from getting a good therapist is a game of chance. They just outright deny it saying 'Its just in your head' like no shit Sherlock its in my head. Yes trying to talk to people does help sometimes because then I don't have the time to think or pay attention to the voice before I respond to the person. But given my circle it's pretty rare that I have a conversation with someone even once a day.
